projects.name: Leo's Toy Rotation
projects.description: Picks one toy per category for Leo every other Friday at 5pm. Rate the last set, swap or hand-pick toys, then confirm to update the toy sheet and email the list.
projects.notes:
Toy sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1FOxLlQe8fKy9fXsXsq5efUUEieQTIvtWTMWyUG-i__I/edit
Snapshots (Toy History folder): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1iZ_whg7oDBPRvPVYj7Y7PCN_qu20Gixk

The Code link opens the Google Apps Script project. After changing the code, publish with Deploy > Manage deployments > Edit > New version so the page link stays the same.
Sheet menu (Toy Rotation): open page, send reminder now, refresh pictures, sort toys, save or restore a snapshot.

projects.name: Agent Maker
projects.description: Describe a role (tax preparer, chef, day planner) and get an agent that does that job. Give it documents and it makes documents, spreadsheets, calendar events and task lists, fills PDF forms, drafts Gmail emails and works with Google Drive.
projects.notes:
Open it in Claude while signed in. The first time, it asks permission to use Claude, and again the first time an agent uses Gmail or Google Drive.

Tabs per agent: Chat (ask it to do work), Work (files, tasks and what it remembers), Documents (upload PDFs, photos or text it reads), Skills & setup (refine it in plain words or edit directly).

Agents and documents are saved privately to your Claude account. Black out SSNs and account numbers before uploading.

To change the app, open the Claude project "ai agent maker" and ask for the change.
